description: What just happened and what is next, straight from the graph: the last N decisions, the ROADMAP, and any inline human question such as an imported ADR awaiting explicit approve/decline. Call at session start to orient, or before planning. Same data as the wiki's now.md. Public store only — except that a queued commit-repair's liveness is checked against the full store, so a private-overlay decision's answerable repair does not go silently unanswerable; only its id and commit shas ever surface, never its title.

recent_limit.description: How many recent decisions to include (default 5).

roadmap_limit.description: How many roadmap entries to include (default 2); the rest are counted.

name: hunch_now
title: Recent activity + the roadmap (the hot view)
